_comment: Reviewed license exceptions for scripts/check-licenses.py (ADR-0003). One entry per package, exact version: a version bump re-opens the review. Every entry needs a written reason; an entry that matches no package fails the check. 'license' is what the package really carries; a license that is neither allowed nor denied is accepted here as a reviewed exception. 'scopes' limits where the entry applies (src, tests, other).

overrides.license: Oracle Free Distribution, Hosting, and Use Terms
overrides.reason: Declared as a LICENSE.txt file, not an SPDX id. Oracle's free-use terms: free to use, not open source. Accepted for test projects only, never under csharp/src (the checker enforces it); today Craticula.Integration.Tests.

Declared as a LICENSE.txt file, not an SPDX id. Microsoft's native runtime pulled in by Microsoft.Data.SqlClient (MIT); free to use and redistribute under Microsoft's terms. Test projects only (Craticula.Integration.Tests), not shipped in any package of csharp/src.
Declares only a licenseUrl (the xunit repository's license.txt), no SPDX id. The xunit project is Apache-2.0. Pulled in by xunit; test projects only.
